title: Thread and synchronisation port
when_to_use: Thread creation, mutexes, condition variables, read-write locks or thread-local storage must be rebuilt on POSIX.
covers: read-write lock lifecycle and static init
boundary: Primitive mapping and the common locking contract. Thread pools, work queues, async notification, atomics and futex tuning are outside.
verification: thread result and abrupt exit values
per-thread TLS values and destructor order
build with and without the threading feature flag
